summary: The candidate follows from the supplied predecessor facts with the stated constants and normalizations. Each whole cross label is counted on exactly two distinct missed dyadic edges and on exactly two distinct original parent edges; endpoint and parent feasibility give the claimed edgewise capacities, and aggregation of coincident atoms preserves both total mass and the intrinsic support ranks. The reflected-cloud, centroid-submeasure, and original-contact arguments use respectively the exact R_cloud, M_off, and halfspace-domination normalizations, yielding masses and lower bounds with no duplicated capacity. Rearrangement of the hard ledger and of the pooled and ancestral scores gives exactly the strict constants 400, 200, 400, 200, and 800 in the five rank screens. No use is made of an identification between dyadic loads and original reservoir loads, and all nonzero-support and zero-congestion cases are handled correctly.
